scenes.title: Hiding Out in Tokyo
scenes.summary: Lying low in Tokyo in 1982, Muranishi plays handheld electronic games in a kind hostess's apartment while she gets ready for work and asks him never to leave.

scenes.title: Returning to Hokkaido
scenes.summary: Toshi and Kitamori secretly meet Muranishi in Tokyo to report daily police harassment at the bookstores, convincing Muranishi to slip out late at night and visit Hokkaido.

scenes.title: Ambush in Susukino
scenes.summary: Back in Sapporo past a wanted poster, Muranishi notices Kitamori sweating nervously, bolts from a police ambush with Toshi through Susukino, and boards a tour bus.
scenes.location: Susukino shop and Sapporo tour bus

scenes.title: Arrested on the Tour Bus
scenes.summary: Waiting aboard the bus, Detective Takei muses about soy-sauce and miso ramen before arresting Muranishi and Toshi and declaring that the state decides what counts as indecent.

scenes.title: Scolding in Detention and Studio Perfection
scenes.summary: Kozue berates Muranishi in the detention visiting room while whispering that the family needs his income, and in Tokyo Poseidon boss Ikezawa demands perfection on a photo shoot.
scenes.location: detention visiting room and Poseidon studio

scenes.title: The Video Format War
scenes.summary: Over fine tea at Poseidon, an electronics executive asks Ikezawa for help in the home video war, and Ikezawa unveils his first adult video tape as a free gift for VCR buyers.

scenes.title: Two Lonely Souls From Fukushima
scenes.summary: Released in Sapporo, Muranishi bonds with a video-parlor proprietress over their shared Fukushima dialect, pickled herring, and memories of her late husband at Sapporo Station.
scenes.location: Sapporo video parlor and upstairs room

scenes.title: Next Stop Tokyo
scenes.summary: Toshi leaves prison and reunites with Muranishi, and together they visit Kawada in his editing room and persuade him to quit his job and join them in Tokyo.

scenes.title: Starting a Video Revolution
scenes.summary: Naming Kawada company president, Muranishi vows to turn the established adult video industry upside down as distributor Furuya welcomes them to a spacious Tokyo office.

scenes.title: Dreams of Studying in Italy
scenes.summary: At dinner after art class, college student Megumi tells her mother Kayo she hopes to study painting in Italy someday, prompting Kayo to plead with her never to leave.
scenes.location: university art studio and Italian restaurant

scenes.title: Bring a Warrant Next Time
scenes.summary: Detective Takei barges into the new office while Toshi watches baseball on television, until company president Kawada calmly steps forward and demands a warrant for future visits.

scenes.title: Pitching a Loan at the Bank
scenes.summary: Seeking startup financing at a bank, Kawada and Muranishi ask a skeptical loan officer about his home VCR and get him to admit how adult tapes drive video adoption.

scenes.title: Two Eager New Recruits
scenes.summary: Toshi arrives in a bargain car with two new recruits—an aspiring film director and a former amateur rugby player whom Muranishi promptly nicknames Rugby.

scenes.title: Standing Up for the Actress
scenes.summary: While preparing props on set, makeup artist Reika teaches the rookies industry tricks and speaks up when an aggressive talent manager threatens a reluctant young actress.

scenes.title: Muranishi Takes Charge of the Set
scenes.summary: After cheerful actress Naoko arrives, Muranishi sends both the frightened girl and the arrogant hired film crew home and puts his own recruits on camera, lighting, and sound.

scenes.title: Racing the Setting Sun
scenes.summary: Taking the camera himself, Muranishi walks the cast through his dramatic story, urges the crew to capture every expression without shadows, and races sunset toward an explosive finale.
scenes.location: outdoor bus and baseball field set

scenes.title: A Wrap Toast Over Budget Fare
scenes.summary: At a lively wrap party over inexpensive pig's feet, the crew praises the lead actress to tears, Muranishi pinky-promises to work with her again, and Ikezawa welcomes a growing video market.
scenes.location: Tokyo barbecue restaurant and night club

scenes.title: Ending theme music
scenes.summary: Closing musical theme begins over the end of the episode.

scenes.title: Final credits
scenes.summary: Final credits roll to the end of Episode 3.
